label: Opus 5.5 · agent 3
source: harbor run -p harbor/lightlag-live -a opencode -m anthropic/claude-opus-5-5 --ak version=1.19.5 (Harbor 0.25.0), on the real clock
note: Wrote a 15 kB autopilot in one go, tested it once against a mock of its own and started the campaign three minutes into the session. It started its program in the form task 0.1.1 suggested, behind a `cd`, and its shell tool killed the program 120 seconds into the campaign, in mission 3 (docs/lightlag-live.md, "The launch trap"; fixed in 0.1.2). The agent noticed 125 seconds later and restarted the program late in mission 5, so missions 4 and 5 scored 0. As played: 0.320. program/ holds the autopilot as copied out of the agent's container during the campaign; uninterrupted/ is that program replayed by lightlag_live.sandbox on the same six missions without the interruption: 0.509 (0.50 0.80 0.35 0.33 0.62 0.44). OpenCode exited with code 1 after its closing report, which Harbor records as an exception; the grade is unaffected.
